text: Wrenfield Logistics has about 2,200 employees, and every day, HR, IT Support, and Operations field the exact same questions over email and Slack.
Priya Desai's HR team re-answers parental leave and benefits questions. Omar Haddad's IT team re-answers VPN and password questions. The real answers already exist.
They're just sitting in Azure Blob Storage, in the wrenfield-knowledge-docs container -- hr-policies, it-wiki, and ops-sops -- hard to search fast enough to beat asking a person.
You're Jordan Vance, Wrenfield's AI Engineer, and this series follows you building a system to fix exactly that.
Next: turning 'answer from our docs' into one precise, testable requirement.
